instruction: Change the title on slide 5 to 'Game Rules' and set the background color of slide 6 to red.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully identified slides with real people images, set their backgrounds to yellow, and changed slide 2 title to 'Let's start'. Completed in 35 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate between slides, change slide background colors, edit title text, identify visual content in slides, use Slide Properties dialog
metadata.task_rationale: Tests same capabilities (title editing + background color change) on different slides with different target values
metadata.explanation: Task requires changing slide 5 title from 'How to Play?' to 'Game Rules' and setting slide 6 background to red. Getter reads slide 5 title text (largest font) and slide 6 background color. Metric gives 0.5 partial credit for each correct step.

llm_judge_reasons: Both instruction requirements (title change on slide 5 and background color on slide 6) are verified with 0.5 partial credit each, providing complete coverage.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' by directly accessing expected.get('expected_title') etc.
Getter correctly targets slide 5 (index 4) for title and slide 6 (index 5) for background color using python-pptx API.
Postconfig saves the file with Ctrl+S before getter reads it, ensuring state freshness.
Expected values ('Game Rules' and 'FF0000') are semantically correct for the instruction.
Minor: Title comparison uses substring containment (expected_title.lower() in actual_title.lower()) rather than exact match, which is slightly lenient but acceptable for this specific title.
Minor: Getter title detection always checks paragraphs[0].runs[0].font.size regardless of current paragraph iteration, but for typical title shapes the first paragraph contains the title text.
